description: FONDU is a team of four passionate innovators from Morocco, bringing together skills in programming, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and technology. We are curious problem-solvers who believe in collaboration, creativity, and using science and technology to address real-world challenges. Our goal is to build innovative solutions and make a positive impact through the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
summary:
EARTH MEMORY is a scientific environmental research platform that investigates how precipitation, soil moisture, and vegetation change together over time. Using NASA Earth observation data, our project explores whether relationships between these environmental signals can reveal patterns that may be missed when each variable is analyzed separately.

The project brings together data processing, quality control, spatial and temporal integration, and scientific analysis. We have developed pilot data workflows and validation studies across different environmental contexts, including the Southern Great Plains and Arizona in the United States. We are also screening Souss-Massa, Morocco, as a potential research region.

Our long-term goal is to build an interactive platform that helps users explore environmental evidence, compare regions, and better understand the changing signals of our planet.
